tenant_taxonomy.Virtual Seller: Pembekal Maya (virtual_seller - quota allocation holder selling commodities)
tenant_taxonomy.Virtual Buyer: Pembeli Maya (buyer_with_quota - quota allocation holder purchasing commodities)
tenant_taxonomy.Actual Seller: Pembekal Fizikal (actual_supplier - physical mill, producer, or importer)

impersonation_rules.exit_button: Must dynamically display 'Kembali sebagai [Nama SuperAdmin]' / 'Return as [SuperAdmin Name]', fetching SuperAdmin's full name from database. NEVER hardcode SuperAdmin name.
impersonation_rules.sidebar_role_badge: While impersonating a tenant, the sidebar peranan badge MUST resolve to the IMPERSONATED TENANT'S OPERATIONAL ROLE (e.g. Pembekal Maya / Pembeli Maya), NOT SUPERADMIN.
impersonation_rules.impersonated_profile: Clicking My Profile & Hierarchy (/profile) under impersonation MUST render the IMPERSONATED TENANT'S PROFILE, SSM number, tenant role, and assigned Upline Master Mediator.
impersonation_rules.topbar_user_avatar: Topbar user avatar MUST display the IMPERSONATED TENANT'S NAME with an [IMPERSONATING] badge and exit return button in the dropdown.

tenant_management_table.action_buttons: All Mediator and subtenant rows MUST display uniform clean text buttons: [ Lihat ] [ Edit ] [ Gantung ].
tenant_management_table.superadmin_mediator_exclusion: Master Mediator #1 (Demo Trading Sdn Bhd), which is SuperAdmin's primary Mediator account line, MUST NOT have a Gantung (Suspend) button.

interactive_column_header_sorting.indicator: Every table column header (<th>) MUST render interactive ▲▼ up & down sort indicators.
interactive_column_header_sorting.hierarchy_preservation_rule: On hierarchical tables (/admin/tenants), sorting by column MUST pin Master Mediator parent rows (M1, M2, M3) at the top and re-sort ONLY subtenant child rows under each Master Mediator, 100% preserving parent-child hierarchy.

deposits_and_escrow_discipline.refunded_deposit_balance: Deposits with status REFUNDED MUST display active balance = RM 0.00 (with original amount shown in strikethrough).
deposits_and_escrow_discipline.movements_drilldown: Drilling down into a deposit MUST render the complete Deposit Movements Audit Trail (+ RM [Amount] Inbound, - RM [Amount] Refund Outbound, Ending Balance RM 0.00).

order_line_items_and_totals.calculated_totals: Order total amounts MUST be dynamically computed from line item inputs (Quantity × Unit Price + Quota Fees), NOT manually keyed-in values.
order_line_items_and_totals.drilldown: Every recent order line on the dashboard MUST be clickable (cursor-pointer) to drill down directly to order details.

code_robustness.nullable_user_signatures: NavigationMenuService::resolveRole(?User $user, $tenant) MUST accept nullable User to prevent 500 errors when auth state is uninitialized.
code_robustness.report_controller_defaults: ReportController methods MUST default null tenantId to 1 when TenantContextService::currentId() returns null for SuperAdmin.
